title: The automatic pictures of every watch screen are never compared with anything, so a blank or wrong screen still passes
what: About 36 checks draw each older watch screen (rest timer, rest is over, no workout, saved, phone not connected, permissions and more) in bright and dim form. They are always saved as new pictures and never compared with an approved picture. Each check only proves a picture was made, is the watch's size, and that nothing touches the round edge. A screen that comes out empty or shows the wrong words passes.
expected: Each screen check also proves the screen shows what it should: either compared with an approved picture, or by checking the key words and numbers on it are drawn.
fix_line: Add a check that the key words of each screen are drawn, or compare with approved pictures

title: The watch keeps two separate sets of rest screens, so a fix to one can miss the other
what: The rest timer, the 'Rest is over' screen and the next-set screen each exist twice: an older version shown when the phone does not take sets from the watch, and a newer logging version shown when it does. They are drawn by different code with their own layouts. A fix made to one set (size, words, colour) does not reach the other. The notification check is also written out twice in the same way.
expected: One rest timer and one 'Rest is over' screen, with the logging buttons added only when logging is on, or a clear plan to retire the older screens.
how_often: every change to a rest screen
fix_line: Retire the older rest screens once every phone takes sets from the watch, or share one screen
